#summary Autoload package explained

= Autoload =

Autoload parses config files for the directories, scans them for files and save
className => directoryPath hashes. 

When it is asked for className it would be automatically loaded from the hash.

== Dependencies: ==

To use autoload it should be included.

Here is the example of the autoload class include:
{{{
require_once('chair/autoload/autoload.php');
}}}

== Interface: ==

{{{
Autoload::watch('path/to/autoload/config.xml');
}}}

== Format of autoload.xml config ==

{{{
<autoload>
    <directory>path/to/the/directory/</directory>
    <directory>another/path/to/the/directory/</directory>
</autoload>
}}}
